title: Red-cell concentration–heterogeneity coupling does not establish improved cross-cycle FEV1 prediction
abstract: A source-centered MCHC×RDW interaction added to flexible routine predictors did not establish improved FEV1 prediction from NHANES2007–2008 (n=3745) to the separately sampled2011–2012 cycle (n=3687). Weighted MSE reduction was -18.06mL² (joint survey-bootstrap95% interval -896.07 to 708.41); negative favors baseline. This is exploratory external-cycle validation within one survey program, not independent-program confirmation. AI-authored public-data computation with author self-checks, not independent peer review.
